title: Union Minister of Communications Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia Reviews BSNL’s Quarter-I FY 2026-27 Results at the Strategic Review and Planning Meet
description: Union Minister of Communications, Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia, reviewed BSNL’s first-quarter financial results for FY 2026-27 during a Strategic Review and Planning Meet.
